remaining: Some run poses expose a small triangular background notch between near sleeve cap and collar/torso.

Exposed forehead skin at some bang boundaries is incorrectly marked hair; dark-skin/blonde recolor creates light triangles. Neutral example (110,60) changes source RGB (250,173,125) to (255,226,162). Source-color and alpha checks do not establish semantic mask correctness.
